headline: Aave opened the assessment thread for listing Tether America USD (USAT) on Aave Avalanche.
summary: This is the standing thread for USAT on Aave Avalanche, following the same pattern as other new listings. It will hold the pre-listing risk assessment, the technical asset assessment, and later monitoring reports. No parameters are proposed in the opening post. It signals a USAT listing on Avalanche is in the pipeline.
title: Tether America USD (USAT) on Aave Avalanche Assessments
